name: bld4_prime_dvd_fib_pred_mul_fib_mul_fib_succ
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : p ∣ Nat.fib (p - 1) * Nat.fib p * Nat.fib (p + 1)
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime), p ∣ Nat.fib (p - 1) * Nat.fib p * Nat.fib (p + 1)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.p3_aux_fib_prime and Mathlib2.an_cassini_int: p = 2 and p = 5 by computation (F_3 = 2, F_5 = 5). Otherwise p3_aux_fib_prime gives F_p ≡ 5^(p/2), so F_p^2 ≡ 5^(p−1) ≡ 1 mod p by Fermat; an_cassini_int at n = p − 1 gives F_{p+1} F_{p−1} = F_p^2 + (−1)^p = F_p^2 − 1 ≡ 0 mod p.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ Nat.fib (p - 1) * Nat.fib p * Nat.fib (p + 1)
